payout_quote: If you have an automated investing account open at the time your referred friend makes a Qualifying Deposit, Betterment will provide a $150 investing bonus into an eligible automated investing account (the 'Sender Investing Bonus') on or around the date of your friend's Qualifying Deposit.
steps: Be a Betterment client with a funded account at the time of referral (U.S. residents only).
Send the referral via the Betterment interface or share your referral code, including the required disclosure that you receive compensation.

Your friend signs up using your designated link/code and makes a Qualifying Deposit within 30 days of signup: $10+ of new funds into a new Cash Reserve account, or $100+ into an individual automated investing account (taxable or IRA).

If you hold a qualifying automated investing account when your friend's Qualifying Deposit completes, you receive the $150 Sender Investing Bonus into an eligible automated investing account on or around the Reward Date.
If you hold a Cash Reserve account, you also get a 0.75% APY boost on up to $1,000,000 of Cash Reserve balance for 92 days (both rewards if you hold both account types).
catches: The $150 is an investing bonus (deposited into your automated investing account), not cash in hand - and it is treated as interest for tax reporting purposes.
Cap: Sender Rewards for no more than 5 referrals per calendar year.
The $150 requires you to hold a qualifying automated investing account when your friend qualifies; self-directed investing and 401(k) accounts do not qualify you.

Friend must be a brand-new client (no pre-existing Betterment accounts) and must fund within 30 days of signup - deposits into self-directed, 401(k), joint/trust investing, HSA, or Checking accounts do not qualify.
You must include a specific disclosure with every referral ('FYI - I'm a client of Betterment and, if you fund a new account, I receive compensation...').
Betterment can terminate the program or refuse/recover rewards at any time; rewards not valid with other offers.
The 0.75% APY boost applies for 92 days and is capped at 6 months aggregate across all referrals.
biggest_catch: The $150 is an investing-account bonus (taxed as interest), not cash - and you only get Sender Rewards for 5 referrals per calendar year.
eligibility: Betterment clients with a funded account at the time of referral; U.S. residents only. Referred friend must be a new client with no pre-existing Betterment accounts.
timing: $150 Sender Investing Bonus paid on or around the date of the friend's Qualifying Deposit; APY boost runs 92 days from the completed Qualifying Deposit.
